name: Send this to your person
title: “You're stuck with me.”
note: Ecclesiastes 4:9-10, 3 slides; photo 2 shows him raising the umbrella over her rather than a twirl
caption:
For the one who always helps you back up. Send this to them.

Life is not meant to be carried alone. When one of you stumbles, the other is right there, and that is a gift worth being thankful for today.

Ecclesiastes 4:9-10 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
